name: Everyone Is Equal
overview: Scripture reveals that all people are created equally in the image of God, male and female alike, emphasizing inherent dignity and worth (Genesis 1:27). God shows no partiality or favoritism, as affirmed by Peter and Paul, highlighting that salvation through Christ is available to everyone who believes, regardless of background (Acts 10:34; Romans 2:11; John 3:16). Furthermore, humanity shares a common origin, made from one blood, underscoring unity and equality among all nations (Acts 17:26). Yet, all have sinned and fall short of God's glory, pointing to the universal need for redemption through Jesus Christ (Romans 3:23).
